card: Keep short links and a bio page together.
title: Trizlink for the links you share
intro: Trizlink gives a shared link a shorter address and a place to see its clicks. A bio page can hold several destinations.

sections.heading: What does Trizlink make?
sections.body: It makes shorter links and link-in-bio pages, with click analytics alongside them.

sections.heading: Can a link carry your own name?
sections.body: You can use a branded link with a custom slug.

sections.heading: How can you see what was opened?
sections.body: Click information sits beside link-in-bio pages and custom domains.

sections.heading: Where does Trizlink fit beside LifeWell?
sections.body: LifeWell keeps the people behind your links. Trizlink gives the links themselves short addresses, bio pages and click information.
